facts.quote: StackAdapt ranks 24 with a 918 percent in revenue growth from 2017 to 2020.

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, companies must have been in business for at least four years.

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, companies must have revenues of at least $5 million.
facts.quote: have revenues of at least $5 million, be headquartered in Canada

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, companies must invest a minimum of five percent of gross revenues in R&D.

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program ranks Canada's 50 fastest-growing technology companies by revenue-growth percentage over the past four years.
facts.quote: recognizes Canada’s 50 fastest-growing technology companies with the highest revenue-growth percentage over the past four years.

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program was in its 24th year in 2021.
facts.quote: Now in its 24th year, the program runs alongside the broader North American Technology Fast 500™
